item.description:
Rename, archive or delete a session from the notch
- More (Command+K) on a card and in the list: rename, archive or delete a session, as far as its agent allows - Works for the Claude app, Claude Code in a terminal, Codex, OpenCode and pi - Welcome back after can be Off (Settings, Notifications): the card then opens only when you hover or ask - The list shows the New session shortcut you set, not Option+Command+N - With Grok Bot or Dots in front, the notch no longer speaks up about their bots - A card's footer reads Back, Reply, Preview, Open

Herdr's app and your character at the notch
- Herdr's desktop app: its sessions wear Herdr's icon, and you can pick up, reply and reopen them from the notch - New session asks where a terminal agent opens: Terminal, Ghostty, cmux, agterm or Herdr - Character at the notch (Settings, Notifications): your character waits in the notch when an agent asks, and gets impatient - Grok Bot shows a bot at work as working, and a choice you pick is pressed without bringing Grok Bot forward - Question cards no longer flicker while they wait - Finer, rounder icons throughout

Grok Bot, Muse, Oh My Pi and Dots
- Grok Bot: each bot is a row wearing its own avatar, and you answer its questions and reply from the notch - Muse Code in any terminal: its sessions are listed with live status, and you can reply and pick up from the notch - Oh My Pi works like pi, and Perch answers its questions from the notch - Dots (ChatGPT Pro, beta): each dot is a row, and Pick up opens it - Settings and setup group your agents by kind, and you can switch off a terminal like tmux to hide its sessions - Several Oh My Pi or Muse sessions in one folder each go back to the right pane - Click the character for a different reaction each time

Send feedback from the notch
- Settings has a Send feedback page: your words, files, an optional email, and Return sends - Drop, paste or attach files (Command+O), pictures shrink to fit, and Email it instead is there if it can't send - Settings is a short list of categories, and each row says what it is set to - The Version row shows your update right on the list - The Claude app's side chats no longer show up in the list

See your reply land
- A reply sent from the notch ends on a Sent line, so you know it went - The shortcut that opens Perch opens the question the notch is showing - New sessions started in the Claude app send again, also right after you trust the folder - Cancel Claude's trust question and the notch says Didn't start at once, your words kept - What's new keeps its place as you scroll, and scrolling lists no longer jitter

Answer a question in your own words
- When an agent asks you to choose, Other lets you type your own answer right on the card - Perch looks for updates every hour and says so with a quick peek in the notch; nothing installs until you press Update - A question's choices light one at a time under the pointer, and each choice's note shows in full - On the notch, Command+Option+O opens the session in its app, and clicking the question opens it on the card - An OpenCode answer with a comma in it stays one answer
